summary: Wave 8 CRM/Leads/Marketing/Projects/Events adversarial cross-review. Cross-tenant FK checks (assertSameTenantFk) in projects/events/campaigns/briefings services correctly run before their DB writes in both create() and update(); the update()-only-validate-when-present logic is sound because dtoToEntity's undefined-check faithfully mirrors whether the original camelCase DTO key was present in the patch -- no bypass found, and null-clearing an FK is safely short-circuited by assertSameTenantFk's own !id guard. Two real defects found instead: (1) HIGH, apps/api/src/modules/campaigns/campaigns.service.ts: update()'s new dtoToEntity() path overwrites the entire metadata JSON column using only the current PATCH's currency/platforms/metadata, never reading current.metadata (already fetched via findById) -- an update sending only {currency:'USD'} silently deletes a previously-stored platforms array or any other prior metadata key. campaigns.service.spec.ts only tests create(), never update(), so this is unguarded. (2) MEDIUM, apps/api/src/modules/leads/handlers/lead-events.handler.ts: the new LEAD_CONVERTED idempotency guard (leadRepo.findOne then much-later writes) is TOCTOU-racy -- runInTenantContext only sets RLS session context, not a DB transaction/lock, so genuine concurrent duplicate event delivery for the same lead (distinct from the documented CLOSED->INACTIVE->NEW->CLOSED re-progression) can still create duplicate client+artist pairs; only sequential mocked scenarios are tested.
